description.value: Home Restaurant is a community staple in Salmon Arm, serving classic North American comfort food for over two decades from its perch near the Salmon Arm Wharf and surrounding hiking trails. Part of a small BC chain, the Salmon Arm location is a sit-down diner-style restaurant with a broad menu spanning all-day breakfast, burgers, and house-made pies. Its location at the top of the hill near outdoor recreation corridors makes it a natural refueling stop for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active multi-location BC comfort food chain with the Salmon Arm location at 2801 10th Avenue N.E., matching the OSM address; the site shows a 2026 Spring menu indicating current operation. Takeout and third-party delivery (DoorDash, Skip the Dishes) are explicitly listed; multiple menu items are marked GF. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi (despite OSM internet_access=wlan) appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM tags internet_access=wlan but Wi-Fi is not mentioned anywhere in the website content; cannot confirm.
OSM addr:housenumber '11-2801' (implying unit 11) differs slightly from website address '2801 – 10th Avenue N.E.' which omits a unit number; postal code and street agree.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established sit-down restaurant near the Salmon Arm Wharf and hiking trails; takeout options and GF menu items make it a practical and verifiable stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly marked GF, including Eggs Only Breakfast, Broccoli & Cheddar Omelette, Ham & Swiss Omelette, HOME Country Omelette, and Farmer's Sausage & Eggs
